beats.text: Six lies you tell yourself that quietly keep you stuck.
One. 'I'll start when I feel ready.' You won't. Readiness is something action creates.
Two. 'I don't have time.' You have the same hours as everyone you admire. It's priorities.
Three. 'It's too late for me.' The best time was years ago. The second best is right now.
Four. 'I'm just not that kind of person.' Identity follows action, not the other way round.
Five. 'If it's meant to be, it'll happen.' Nothing meaningful arrives without you moving first.
Six. 'I'll be happy once I get there.' There always moves. Happiness is built on the way.
The fog isn't the world. It's the story. Change the story, and the road appears.
